channel.title: River Bend Outdoors
channel.description: Outdoor stories, field notes, and practical guides from River Bend Outdoors.

item.title: What Do Those Colored Marks on Trees Mean? An East Lyme Trail Blaze Guide
item.description: Blue, red, white, or two colors together—East Lyme's trail markers tell more than one story. Here's how to read them without assuming every park follows the same rules.

item.title: Oswegatchie Hills: Trails, Ponds, and a Few Surprises
item.description: Beyond the ballfields, rocky trails lead toward Clark Pond—a quiet stretch of water with a surprising history tied to Niantic’s fishing fleet.

item.title: Darrow Pond: A Park Worth Watching
item.description: A quiet East Lyme pond, a protected piece of open space and a new trail grant that could make the place easier to explore.
